change_summary: Shift /api/v2/* traffic from legacy-api backend to new api-v2-service via nginx ingress annotation update
diff_or_config:
# k8s/ingress/api-gateway.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: api-gateway
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/canary: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/canary-weight: "10"
spec:
  rules:
  - host: api.company.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /api/v2
-       backend:
-         service: legacy-api
-         port: 8080
+       backend:
+         service: api-v2-service
+         port: 8080
service_context: api-gateway (nginx ingress controller), serves 10k RPM. /api/v2 handles ~3.2k RPM from mobile clients and 2 internal services.
deployment_plan: Canary rollout: 10% traffic for 30min, then 50% for 1h, then 100% if error rate stays below 0.1%.
blast_radius: All /api/v2 consumers: mobile app (iOS/Android), order-service, notification-service.
validation_evidence: api-v2-service passes full integration test suite. Load tested at 5k RPM with p99 < 80ms.

seeded_gaps.description: No rollback plan for reverting traffic if new backend fails
No observability evidence for monitoring the new backend during canary
No alerting configured for error rate or latency on new routing path
No SLO or reliability impact assessment for routing change
